title: Bihar Board Class 10th / 12th Dummy Registration Card 2027
postName: Dummy Registration Card (Dummy Panjiyan Card) – Matric & Intermediate Annual Exam 2027
vacancyDetails: Dummy registration card for Bihar Board Class 10th (Secondary/Matric) and Class 12th (Intermediate) students of session 2025-27 appearing in Annual Examination 2027
qualification: Students enrolled in 2025-27 session for Class 10th (Secondary) or Class 12th (Intermediate) Annual Examination 2027, whose school/college submitted online registration and declaration on time
applicationFee: As paid during school/college registration process
selectionProcess: School registration → Dummy registration card verification → Final registration card → Admit card → Board examination
documentsRequired: School/College Code; Student Name; Father Name; Date of Birth (as per school records); Faculty (Arts/Science/Commerce/Vocational) for Class 12th only
howToApply:
1. Visit biharboardonline.org (Class 10th) or intermediate.biharboardonline.com (Class 12th)
2. Open the link “Download Dummy Registration Card”
3. Enter School/College Code, Student Name, Father Name and Date of Birth
4. Class 12th students: also select Faculty (Arts / Commerce / Science / Vocational)
5. Solve captcha and click Submit
6. Download / print the dummy registration card and verify all details
7. Report any error to school/college within the download window for correction
shortDescription: Bihar Board Class 10th / 12th Dummy Registration Card 2027 released. Download Dummy Panjiyan Card from 25 July to 14 August 2026 at biharboardonline.org and intermediate.biharboardonline.com.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the online Dummy Registration Card (Dummy Panjiyan Card) 2027 for Class 10th (Matric/Secondary) and Class 12th (Intermediate) students of the 2025-27 session appearing in the Annual Examination 2027.

Students can download the card from the official BSEB portals from 25 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 using School Code, Student Name, Father Name and Date of Birth. Class 12 students must also select Faculty.

Quick Overview

  • Board: Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB)
  • Document: Dummy Registration Card (Dummy Panjiyan Card)
  • Classes: 10th (Secondary) & 12th (Intermediate)
  • Exam: Annual Examination 2027
  • Session: 2025-27
  • Download window: 25 July 2026 – 14 August 2026

Official Download Portals

  • Class 10th: biharboardonline.org
  • Class 12th: intermediate.biharboardonline.com (Student Dummy Registration Card download)

Details to Verify on the Card

  • Student name and photograph
  • Father’s name and mother’s name
  • Date of birth and gender
  • Category / subjects / faculty
  • School or college name and code

Correction

If any detail is wrong, inform your school or college immediately so they can update the record on the BSEB portal. After correction, download the card again and re-check. Correcting errors at the dummy stage avoids issues on the final registration card, admit card and marksheet.

For Schools / Colleges

Principals can log in with their User ID and Password from 25 July 2026 and provide two signed and stamped copies of the dummy registration card to each student for verification. Students may also download their own copy online.

Note: Keep School Code, name and DOB ready as per school records. Class 12 students must select the correct Faculty (Arts / Science / Commerce / Vocational).
